title: E-Paper Refresh Lab
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: E-Paper Display
Full Refresh
Partial Refresh
Ghosting
description: Interactive p5.js e-paper refresh lab: step minute by minute or run a whole day with always-full, always-partial or mixed refresh, and compare refresh counts, total refresh time, flashes and a ghost level meter.

learningObjectives: Analyze how full and partial refresh strategies trade speed and flashing against ghosting
Calculate the total refresh time for a day from the counts of each refresh type
Evaluate a value of N that keeps ghosting below the noticeable level with the fewest flashes

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Compare strategies by running the same day three ways
keyQuestions: Why not always use a full refresh?
What happens to an e-paper clock that only uses partial refreshes?
commonMisconceptions: Ghosting is permanent damage (a full refresh clears it)
Partial refresh is always better because it is faster
assessmentOpportunities: Fill in a table comparing the three strategies
Verify the total refresh time by hand

controls.label: Advance one minute
controls.description: Performs one refresh by the chosen rule.

controls.label: Reset
controls.description: Starts over at 07:00 with no ghosting.
